notes.title: Furi Freedom Update
notes.notes:
Hello Riders,

You might have seen that Furi has been updated today across all platforms outside of Steam. As a clarification all the content in the update is already present in the Steam version. Actually some of the content had been developed following feedback from this community here on Steam that has been very helpful. So thank you for helping us fine tune it!

https://youtu.be/lCfHLcXleEk
The content made available across platforms is:
[list]
[*] Invincible Mode
[*] Speedrun in Furier
[*] Bonus boss Bernard from DLC One More Fight or Definitive Edition
[*] Alternate controls D
[*] HUD position adjustment
[/list]
If you haven't checked those features in Furi yet, why not give them a try? It's also a good time to tell your friends about Furi as the game will be 65% off in the Daily Deal starting in a bit.

More details about the update here: https://www.thegamebakers.com/furi-freedom-update/
